comment: Such a nice professor. It was her first time teaching the class so the syllabus/grading was adjusted throughout the semester but everything worked out. A group project, final presentation, and couple papers throughout based on weekly play readings. As someone who isn't a theatre student, THTR 325 is definitely a fun class.
Professor Hughes is one of the most caring professors I have had at UR. She makes a topic that is not the most universally liked easy to get into and engaging. Take her for your gen ed.

This class is SO easy. There are weekly journals that take 10 mins. You don't have to do the reading. No cold-calling or acting. She's super nice and fun. She tries really hard to make class fun and show videos that her students are interested in.
Great professor. The class is basically writing weekly journals and two papers. She is always there to help her students

She's a good person to talk to but veryyyy nitpicky with her essays and assignments. If you don't mention one thing we discussed in class in the journal then she takes points off. Her lectures are pretty boring and she goes on and on about unnecessary things. There are also an insane amount of essays for this class that she is very nitpicky about.

Professor Hughes was awesome. As a theatre kid, I enjoyed it a lot because it was familiar. But even if you don't like theatre or don't have experience, she makes it fun. She has a bubbly/sassy in a good way personality and will try to get you to step out of your comfort zone. Doable work. Gets to know your name and knows most are there for gen ed.

She gives so much homework for it being a theatre class. We had too many essays to count and I took this class thinking it would be easy, but shes an extremely tough grader. Shes very nit picky about her work and if you dont come to class if youre sick or have another reason shell hold that against you and lower your grade. Not an easy class.

took this class not knowing who the professor was gonna be, then she became my favorite!!! she is incredibly funny and extremely easygoing. 2 paragraph reflection journal due every saturday night, but they are really easy. she will learn your name and make you feel comfortable in class. one of my absolute favorite profs at the university.
